symptom: ako/mxcli#2108: describe printed a dynamic image's stored source as `DataSource: $currentObject/Mod.Stock_ItemImage`, and exec refused it: 'a *pages.AssociationSource data source cannot be stored on a Forms$ImageViewerSource, which holds an entity and nothing else'. check passed the same statement.
cause: imageViewerSourceToGen wrote only a database source's DirectEntityRef and refused every other source, on the reasoning that Forms$ImageViewerSource has no slot for an association. It has: EntityRef takes an IndirectEntityRef and SourceVariable the context parameter, exactly the two slots a Forms$DataViewSource uses for 'data from context' over an association.
insight: A refusal written because no reference instance was at hand outlives the measurement that answers it: Studio Pro-stored pages (FactoryManagement, three of them) proved the shape, and the reader already decoded it. When a reader handles a stored form, the writer refusing the same form is a round-trip bug, not caution. Verified on TestApp and PedApp: writes, describe re-emits, re-exec Unchanged; mx check adds only CE0582 (dynamic image on a React client), which the database-source control gets too.
